landscape.label: Local Know-How
landscape.title: Houston Deed Restrictions, HOAs and Historic Districts
landscape.say: Houston has no zoning code, but that does not mean anything goes. Deed restrictions cover many older neighborhoods, and master-planned communities in the suburbs have HOAs with architectural review committees that care about how a house looks from the street. Mirror-like reflective film is the thing most likely to draw a letter.

landscape.label: Why Window Film Here
landscape.title: Why Window Film Pays Off in Houston's Heat and Humidity
landscape.say: Houston's cooling season is long. Air conditioners start working hard in spring and often do not get a real break until fall, and the humidity means nights stay warm enough that the house never fully sheds the day's heat. Every bit of solar energy that comes through the glass is heat the AC has to pull back out, on top of the moisture it is already removing from the air.

Decorative & Frosted Glass: Frosted bands, logos and patterned film for office partitions, entry doors and glass walls, with clean cut lines, branding options and easy removal at the end of a lease. landscape.title: How an install works

On site they identify the glazing

landscape.say: Here's how an install works. First, use the quote form to list window sizes and the rooms or spaces that bother you. Then, on site they identify the glazing, check for factory low-E coatings and failing seals, and tape samples to the actual panes. On install day, they protect floors and sills, clean each pane, cut film to size and squeegee it into place. Finally, film needs time for the remaining moisture to escape.

landscape.say: Common questions: Does window film protect against hurricanes? Safety film holds broken glass together and reduces flying shards, but it is not hurricane-rated impact protection unless it is part of a tested system. What is the lifespan of window film on a Houston house? Interior film on residential glass typically holds up for many years, often longer than a decade, and the film maker's warranty spells out the exact term. Can adding film affect the warranty on my windows? It can.
